reviews.reason: The result requires choosing refinements that kill obstructions in the correct successive bidegrees, in both surjectivity and injectivity directions. This is more than applying a fixed-cover spectral sequence and supports H2.
reviews.core_assessment: Represent a sheaf-cohomology class by a hypercoverCech class by eliminating the successive spectral-sequence obstructions through suitable refinements. For aCech class mapping to zero, refine again to annihilate the higher-differential witnesses, proving injectivity and functoriality of the comparison.
